## Brand Strategy
- "Brand Plus" model: motivation, what we do, promise, attitude
- Motivation: "To push beyond the expected and live a life less ordinary"
- Promise: "We challenge convention to liberate you from the ordinary"
- Attitude: "Lively not hectic, unexpected not silly, bold not aloof"
- Tagline: "Different is better" (reserved for strategic/large-audience comms like TVC, OOH)
- "hellomoto" as revitalized brand greeting
- 85+ year heritage emphasized -- Razr, first mobile cellphone, Moto Z/motomods
- "The Motorola World" concept: young, spirited, future-forward, style + engineering

## Logo
- Motorola logo = wordmark + "Emsignia" (iconic batwing M in circle)
- Three logo versions: Flat color, Outline, Breakout
- Flat color: any brand color except yellow, medium gray, light gray; wordmark always white (black on yellow backgrounds)
- Outline: any brand color; clear-space rules can be broken at large scale; imagery can overlap/interact with Emsignia
- Breakout: expressive/playful variant; must preserve M shape and circular containing shape; requires brand team approval
- White-only exceptions (flat and outline) for special cases, requires approval
- Strict "don'ts": no proportion changes, no solid yellow, no wordmark alone, no "moto" lockup with Emsignia without approval, no infill Emsignia with wordmark, no stacked logo with product imagery/talent
- Lenovo logo co-branding addressed (separate section, p.20+)

Strong strategic foundation (Brand Plus model), flexible logo system with three variants, creative allowances (breakout logo, outline overlaps) balanced with clear restrictions. Covers visual identity comprehensively. The Lenovo co-branding adds complexity.
